tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one URL on a network HTTP agents cannot reach (gemini://, gopher://, ipfs://, ipns://) and return the text verbatim, plus an Ed25519 receipt that offweb fetched this URL at this time and got these bytes. Text only, 1 MiB cap. Refusals carry an `error` and nothing is fetched.

tools.name: about
tools.description: Operator identity (Ley 34/2002 art. 10), the receipt public key, limits and the responsibility boundary.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
